gloss: full of motivation; raring to go; fired up

definitions.gloss: full of motivation; raring to go; highly motivated
definitions.explanation: Overflowing with eagerness and willingness to do something. Describes a state of being extremely motivated and enthusiastic about a task or challenge.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}はやる{気|き}{満々|まんまん}だ。
{新入社員|しんにゅうしゃいん}はみんなやる{気|き}{満々|まんまん}で{出社|しゅっしゃ}してきた。
examples.english: All the new employees came to work raring to go.

examples.japanese: やる{気|き}{満々|まんまん}で{試合|しあい}に{臨|のぞ}んだが、{結果|けっか}は{惨敗|ざんぱい}だった。
examples.english: I went into the match full of motivation, but the result was a crushing defeat.

notes:
Composed of やる{気|き} (motivation, willingness) + {満々|まんまん} (brimming, overflowing). A vivid, expressive phrase commonly used in casual conversation.

ETYMOLOGY:
- やる{気|き}: motivation, eagerness — itself a common standalone word
- {満々|まんまん}: full to overflowing — used in other expressions like {自信|じしん}{満々|まんまん} (brimming with confidence)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- やる{気|き}{満々|まんまん}で{取|と}り{組|く}む: to tackle something with great enthusiasm
- やる{気|き}{満々|まんまん}の{様子|ようす}: looking very motivated
- やる{気|き}{満々|まんまん}で{出発|しゅっぱつ}する: to set off raring to go

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {意欲的|いよくてき}: ambitious, eager — more formal
- やる{気|き}がある: to have motivation — less intense
- {張|は}り{切|き}っている: to be fired up, enthusiastic — similar intensity
- やる{気|き}{十分|じゅうぶん}: having plenty of motivation — slightly less emphatic
